about_p1: Skyline Roofing replaced our roof late last year. During some heavy rain, I noticed some water leaking down that pipe in the attic. Corey was very responsive and had his team come out the next day to locate the issue. The issue wasn’t with the roof but a seal on the vent pipe itself, which they repaired at no cost. Awesome company to do business with. They do great work and are very responsive.
about_p2: Corey is the best! Always by far the most reliable contractors for roofing/siding repairs and replacements. I recommend him to all of my real estate clients, buyers AND sellers. He's amazing at his job and also nice, responsive AND gives honest pricing. I had a great experience using Skyline Roofing. The owner was very quick to respond to my request to look at a roof leak I had.

reviews.author: Mark Chase
reviews.text: Skyline Roofing replaced our roof late last year. During some heavy rain, I noticed some water leaking down that pipe in the attic. Corey was very responsive and had his team come out the next day to locate the issue. The issue wasn’t with the roof but a seal on the vent pipe itself, which they repaired at no cost. Awesome company to do business with. They do great work and are very responsive.

reviews.author: Anousheh Khalili
reviews.text: Corey is the best! Always by far the most reliable contractors for roofing/siding repairs and replacements. I recommend him to all of my real estate clients, buyers AND sellers. He's amazing at his job and also nice, responsive AND gives honest pricing.

reviews.author: Tim Day
reviews.text: I had a great experience using Skyline Roofing. The owner was very quick to respond to my request to look at a roof leak I had. Very professional and took care of the leak in a timely manner. I would highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Shelley Callahan
reviews.text: Skyline is the best! Corey is wonderful. Worked with them for years and it’s always great! Great communication and great job every time - highly recommended!

reviews.author: Deborah Dugger
reviews.text: Prompt and professional work on our slate roof. Wouldn't use anyone else for our roof repair and maintenance!
